# Diminuendo

> Diminuendo is a Fabric-native conversation surface for coding agents. The
> shadcn-stack web client renders live agent streams: text, code, tool
> calls, diffs, plans, approvals, sub-agents, sandboxes, compaction.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): project intent, stack, layout, routes, hookup notes.
- [Codex.app visual reference](https://github.com/openai/codex): the
  decompiled production client whose look this UI replicates pixel-for-pixel.
- [Fabric core](https://github.com/igentai/fabric-core): canonical types
  for `PresentationBlock`, `IngressInputPart`, and stream events.

## Surfaces

- [/](.): project picker and first-turn composer.
- [/thread/:id](thread): live virtualized message stream with the
  Review / Browser / Git / Plan / Inbox side panel.
- [/plugins](plugins): gallery of integrations.
- [/plugins/manage](plugins/manage): Apps / MCPs / Skills / Marketplace
  configuration.
- [/automations](automations): scheduled chats with templates and run
  history.
- [/settings](settings): theme, models, shortcuts, account, data controls.

## Block kinds rendered in chat

markdown, thinking, summary, code, code-result, shell, mermaid, json,
tool-call, tool-result, diff, diff-summary, attachments, image, audio,
video, document, ref, citations, approval, question, plan, mission,
compaction, sandbox, sub-agent, web-fetch, browser-action, error,
token-usage, model-switch, section-heading.

## Backend

Diminuendo connects to a Fabric gateway via WebSocket (default
`ws://127.0.0.1:8001`). The Connector seam at `src/runtime/connector.ts`
isolates the UI from the transport; swap `MockConnector` for
`DiminuendoConnector` to go live.
